UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents an authenticated user account and their RBAC role in EduBank MCQ.

uid.description: The Firebase Authentication UID matching the document ID.

role.description: The RBAC role assigned to the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was created (submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was last updated (submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted administrator lookup document keyed by admin UID.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profile information and RBAC role keyed by the user's Firebase Auth UID.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Read-only lookup collection for administrator UIDs.
